name: Two-century trend following (12m sign)
hypothesis: Trends persist across asset classes: the sign of the trailing 12-month return predicts the next month's return.
signal_rule: For each asset, go long when its trailing 12-month return is positive, flat when negative; equal-weight the longs.
plain_rule: If it went up over the last 12 months, you buy. If it went down, you sit in cash.
claimed_result: Sharpe ~0.8 per asset, ~1.7 diversified, stable for two centuries (paper, gross of costs)
paper_ref: Lemperiere et al. (2014), Two Centuries of Trend Following, arXiv:1404.3274
